scope: Fresh single-depth regional displacement and stress comparison; inspired by Fig.3, not a reproduction.

processing.raw_label: Common 1.25 s source-time function and continuous rate integration already applied; no additional display low-pass. QSSP rate indices were deterministically restored. These are not untouched native displacement files.
processing.integration: Full-period damped Fourier integration of rates by 1/(2*pi*i*(f+i*fi)); native Nyquist endpoint zero.
processing.qseis_STF: 1024 custom samples with native damping compensation; effective common sin-squared moment rate.
processing.spgrn_STF: Native impulse followed by forward multiplication of the common STF spectrum on the full damped FFT.
processing.qssp_rate_sampling: Recover missing x0 from zero native Nyquist; [x1,...,xN-1,xN-1] becomes [x0,...,xN-1].
processing.qssp_original_displacement: Native rectangle-integrated displacement and stress retained and independently checked locally; not included in these plot archives.

filter.applied_to: complete native record before interpolation and crop

processing.alignment: Actual earthquake-origin time, linear interpolation only; no extrapolation.

metric_definitions.paper_energy_misfit: sum((u-ref)^2)/sum(ref^2); printed paper Eq.(14) has no square root
metric_definitions.all_components: Concatenated component samples without component scaling; not amplitude error alone
metric_definitions.source_radius_reference: Named per row; use the reference column
metric_definitions.zero_reference: Null for nonzero residual against a zero-energy reference; zero if both are zero; correlation null if variance vanishes

control_checks.spatial_kernel: exp(-0.5*(k*rdisk)^2), rdisk=rd2r*min(sqrt(zdis^2+r^2),Vp/(f+df)); not a fixed-radius finite fault or temporal STF

custom_STF.definition: 2/T sin(pi*t/T)^2 on [0,T]; QSEIS input compensates native damping

software.validation_scope: This scientific run was executed on Windows; no cross-platform rerun is claimed.

cost_interpretation: Recorded elapsed times partly overlap due to concurrent execution, so they are not a serial performance benchmark. Bytes were recorded before params.json and later summary figures.

changes: qswvint.f: require PGW_FREQ_START and PGW_FREQ_STOP, restrict only the frequency-computation loop; full grns zero initialization and fcut/df/N unchanged
qsfftinv.f: output formats 1004/1005 E12.4 -> E24.15 only
qswvint.f: rd2r .05 ->0 physical point-source control, eps1e-6 unchanged
qswvint.f: PGW_FREQ_START/STOP restrict only computation-loop frequency bounds on unchanged full grid

limitations: QSEIS flat geometry/deep truncation, layer discretization, and wavenumber integration convergence were not separately varied.
No independent spherical-degree convergence sweep was performed; the QSSP 40000 cap was not reached.
Equal STF and spatial point-source controls do not prove all backend waveforms identical.
Downloaded arrays support redrawing and recomputing metrics; they are not complete Green-function libraries or turnkey scripts for rebuilding this 2 Hz experiment.
